note: Directory, prekey-bundle and recipient-resolution cases. directory_cases / bundle_cases: `text` is the JSON text as on the wire; `shape_ok` says whether it is well-formed (checked without any key), `verifies` whether it is then trusted at at_ms under `root` (default root_public_key_hex) - a document that is not well-formed MUST NOT verify even when its signature is genuine. recipient_cases: the (kid, public_key) to encrypt to for org_id in the named directory at at_ms, or null. See docs/SPEC.md (Key directory).

directory_cases.name: valid
directory_cases.why: well-formed, in its window, signed by the trusted root

directory_cases.name: valid-with-no-entries
directory_cases.why: an empty directory is well-formed

directory_cases.name: valid-three-entries-with-encryption-keys
directory_cases.why: the directory the other vectors use

directory_cases.name: signed-by-another-root
directory_cases.why: well-formed, but not signed by the root this verifier trusts

directory_cases.name: before-issued-at
directory_cases.why: evaluated before the directory's own window opens

directory_cases.name: at-valid-until
directory_cases.why: the window is half-open: valid_until itself is outside

directory_cases.name: altered-after-signing
directory_cases.why: a capability added without re-signing

directory_cases.name: entries-contains-null
directory_cases.why: an entry that is not an object

directory_cases.name: capability-itar-as-string
directory_cases.why: itar: "false" is not a boolean (a truthiness test would grant ITAR)

directory_cases.name: capability-unknown-member
directory_cases.why: an unknown capability

directory_cases.name: capabilities-as-array
directory_cases.why: capabilities must be an object

directory_cases.name: duplicate-kid
directory_cases.why: one kid on two entries: which org signed is ambiguous

directory_cases.name: unknown-top-level-member
directory_cases.why: an unknown member on the directory

directory_cases.name: unknown-entry-member
directory_cases.why: an unknown member on an entry

directory_cases.name: missing-entry-member
directory_cases.why: an entry without a status

directory_cases.name: public-key-uppercase-hex
directory_cases.why: hex must be lowercase

directory_cases.name: alg-not-ml-dsa-87
directory_cases.why: the one signature algorithm this version defines

directory_cases.name: status-unknown
directory_cases.why: status is active or revoked

directory_cases.name: entry-window-inverted
directory_cases.why: valid_from must be before valid_until

directory_cases.name: entry-valid-until-as-array
directory_cases.why: a datetime written as a one-element array

directory_cases.name: issued-at-with-offset
directory_cases.why: datetimes are canonical UTC (Z), no offsets

directory_cases.name: enc-alg-without-key
directory_cases.why: enc_alg and enc_public_key come together or not at all

directory_cases.name: enc-key-wrong-length
directory_cases.why: an ML-KEM-1024 key is exactly 1568 bytes

directory_cases.name: enc-alg-unknown
directory_cases.why: the one encapsulation algorithm this version defines

directory_cases.name: org-id-uppercase
directory_cases.why: org_id has the same form as in a traveler

directory_cases.name: kid-with-space
directory_cases.why: a kid is 1-64 of [A-Za-z0-9._-]

directory_cases.name: root-kid-empty
directory_cases.why: root_kid is 1-64 of [A-Za-z0-9._-]

directory_cases.name: entries-as-object
directory_cases.why: entries must be an array

directory_cases.name: unsupported-spec
directory_cases.why: a directory version this specification does not define

directory_cases.name: sig-uppercase-hex
directory_cases.why: the signature bytes are right but the hex is uppercase

directory_cases.name: sig-missing
directory_cases.why: an unsigned directory

directory_cases.why: a repeated member name: a last-wins reader sees the valid directory and never reads the first status

directory_cases.name: byte-order-mark

directory_cases.name: as-array

recipient_cases.name: revoked
recipient_cases.why: a revoked entry is never a recipient

recipient_cases.name: expired
recipient_cases.why: an expired entry is never a recipient
